main.selectBotDescription: Choose a bot from the sidebar to view its profile, or open settings to customize the theme, accent color, and background.
main.welcomeDescription: A bot has a persona, models and a permission preset. Create one to start chatting.

settings.title: Appearance & Settings
settings.subtitle: Customize theme mode, accent color, background media, and interface language.

theme.title: Theme Mode
theme.description: Switch between light, dark, or system color scheme.

accent.title: Accent Color
accent.description: Pick a highlight color for interactive elements and active indicators.

background.title: Background Image
background.description: Choose a local image or animated GIF as the application backdrop.

language.title: Language
language.description: Select the display language for the interface.

hotkey.title: Stop All Global Hotkey
hotkey.description: Emergency shortcut that immediately cancels any active bot run across all screens.

providers.title: Model providers
providers.description: API keys are stored in your OS keychain. The daemon reads providers when it starts.
providers.nativeOnly: Provider management is available in the desktop app.
providers.keyHint: The key is sent to the OS keychain and never shown again.
providers.restartHint: Restart the daemon so it picks up the change.
providers.restartManual: Restart the daemon yourself so it picks up the change (it was not started by this app).

permissions.title: Permissions
permissions.description: What each bot may do right now, including “Always allow” rules you granted from approval cards.
permissions.workspaceDefault: The workspace default for bots without their own policy is “Approve destructive”.
permissions.viaGrant: Allowed because of an “Always allow” rule

overlay.humanDrivingHint: Bot desktop actions are refused while you drive. Click Give back in the mini widget to resume.

widget.humanDrivingStep: You are in control — bot desktop actions are refused.

bots.noChats: No chats yet. Start one with “New chat”.

chat.emptyHint: Say something to start the conversation.

mode.queueHint: Deliver after the current turn finishes
mode.steerHint: Deliver now and redirect the current turn

chat.placeholderBusy: The bot is working — queue or steer…

question.title: The bot asks
question.closed: This question is no longer open.

botForm.name: Name
botForm.avatarInitialsHint: Initials are shown until you pick an image.
botForm.avatarHint: PNG, JPEG, WebP or GIF (GIFs up to 400 KB keep their animation).
botForm.avatarUnreadable: That file could not be read as an image.
botForm.personaPlaceholder: How should this bot behave? (system instruction)
botForm.modelsHint: Pick a provider and type the model name for each role. Only the executor is required.

read-only.name: Read-only
read-only.hint: The bot can look but never change anything.

approve-destructive.name: Approve destructive
approve-destructive.hint: Reads are free; anything that changes or sends asks you first.

read-and-draft.name: Read & draft
read-and-draft.hint: The bot reads and drafts, but never sends or changes things.

custom.name: Custom
custom.hint: Choose a level for each category.

botForm.runtimeHint: Only this machine is supported for now.

usage.title: Usage
usage.subtitle: Tokens used by each bot.
usage.costNote: Cost is not reported by the daemon yet; only token counts are shown.

needs.title: Needs you
needs.subtitle: Approvals and questions waiting across all chats.
